Artificial intelligence (AI) is a set of technologies that enable computers to perform a variety of advanced functions, including the ability to see , understand and translate spoken and written language , analyze data , make recommendations, and more.
AI is the backbone of innovation in modern computing, unlocking value for individuals and businesses.

For example, optical character recognition (OCR ) uses AI to extract text and data from images and documents, turns unstructured content into business-ready structured data, and unlocks valuable insights.
